copy.failed: Copy failed. Select the text and copy it manually.

notice.expired: Your sign-in step expired. Sign in again.

error.lockedSeconds: Too many failed attempts. Sign-in is paused for {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
error.lockedMinutes: Too many failed attempts. Sign-in is paused for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
error.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts from this network. Wait a few seconds, then try again.
error.disabled: This account is disabled. Contact your Termdock administrator.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.trustDeviceHelp: This browser won't ask for a code again until then.
twoFactor.backupIntro: Enter one of the backup codes you saved when you set up two-step verification. Each code works once.
twoFactor.otherAccount: Sign in with a different account

error.invalid: That code is not valid. Check the clock on your device and try again.
error.invalidBackup: That backup code is not valid or was already used.
error.locked: Too many wrong codes. Verification is locked for 15 minutes.
error.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts for this sign-in. Sign in again to get a new verification step.

setup.title: Set up Termdock
setup.intro: Create the first administrator account. This page works once, with the one-time setup token printed in the web service log.
setup.tokenHelp: Copy it from the web service log line that starts with “No user exists yet”.
setup.usernameHelp: 3 to 30 letters, numbers, dots or underscores.

error.token: This setup token doesn't match. Copy it again from the web service log.
error.busy: Setup is already running in another window. Wait a moment and try again.
error.username: Use 3 to 30 letters, numbers, dots or underscores.
error.rejected: The account could not be created. Check the fields and try again.

changePassword.title: Choose a new password
changePassword.intro: Your administrator set a temporary password. Choose your own before you continue. Other browsers signed in to this account will be signed out.
changePassword.newHelp: At least 12 characters, different from the current one.

error.unchanged: Choose a password different from the current one.
error.generic: The password could not be changed. Try again.

enrollTotp.title: Set up two-step verification
enrollTotp.intro: Your account requires a code from an authenticator app at every sign-in.
enrollTotp.passwordHelp: Confirm it's you before a new secret is created.
enrollTotp.scanHelp: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
enrollTotp.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
enrollTotp.manualLabel: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app instead.
enrollTotp.codeHelp: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows to finish.
enrollTotp.doneIntro: Save these backup codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your authenticator. They are shown only now.
enrollTotp.enrolledIntro: This account already signs in with an authenticator code.

error.invalid: That code is not valid. Check the clock on your device and try again.
error.enrolled: Two-step verification is already on for this account.
error.generic: Two-step verification could not be set up. Try again.

bay.label: Sessions
bay.emptyBody: Start one with New session. It keeps running until you end it.
bay.noHosts: Sessions appear here once you add a host.

protection.tmux-control: Protected: survives restarts and network drops
protection.tmux-normal: Protected in compatibility mode: survives restarts and network drops, history restored best-effort
protection.none: Not protected: the shell is lost if the connection drops
protection.pending: Protection is decided when the session starts

tabs.label: Open sessions
tabs.close: Close tab. The session keeps running.

pane.label: Terminal panes
pane.emptyBody: Choose a strip in the bay to open it here. Closing a tab only detaches; the session keeps running on the server.
pane.firstRunBody: Termdock holds SSH sessions open on the server, so you can close the browser and come back to the same screen.
pane.firstRunStep1: Add a host and the credential that reaches it.
pane.firstRunStep2: Check its host key fingerprint and trust it.
pane.firstRunStep3: Start a session. It runs until you end it.
pane.noSessionsBody: Your hosts are ready. Start a session and it will appear in the bay.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address doesn't lead anywhere in Termdock.
